items.summary: Risk disposition: blocked for SearchWoot public beta or full launch; conditional for ordinary reversible growth; human counsel required for upstream rights and any monetization or public-display decision. Exact decision: keep searchwoot.com private and keep permission outreach unsent. Evidence: Woot documentation establishes API access but not commercial/public redistribution, storage, derivatives, caching, alerts, affiliate, advertising, trademark, image, price, attribution, freshness, correction, or takedown rights; public terms point against the proposed use. Four launch-readiness tasks remain active: 0 closed, 4 open. Compliance is technical-only at 37 pass, 16 fail, and 6 unknown; data quality is yellow for analytics permissions/collector errors; operations and fleet-doctor sweeps have no results. Do not treat incomplete telemetry as zero or block ordinary bounded growth solely for that reason. Continue only reversible work preserving consent, disclosures, provenance, claims, platform-policy, and data boundaries.

Launch-readiness tracking remains active. No task closes this cycle because rights, field-level provenance, retention, deletion, correction, access, notification, GA4 settings, vendor coverage, incident procedures, accuracy/freshness, security, attribution, measurement, and owner evidence remain incomplete. Next evidence action: attach one consolidated read-only bundle containing the field-level rights matrix, deployed data-flow and retention table, log/vendor/incident inventory, consent and GA4 configuration evidence, accuracy/freshness controls, and rollback evidence. Keep outreach unsent and do not change production, tracking, credentials, configuration, alert scope, monetization, or launch state.
